summary: EFCAR, LLC, as depositor for Exeter Select Automobile Receivables Trust 2026-2, filed a 424B5 prospectus for a $461.8 million sub-prime auto loan ABS shelf takedown. Offered notes total $461.8 million across Classes A-1 through D, with Class A-1 at 4.311%, Class A-2 at 4.82%, Class A-3 at 5.26%, Class B at 5.40%, Class C at 5.75% and Class D at 6.34%. Credit enhancement includes subordination, overcollateralization, excess spread and a reserve account; distributions begin October 15, 2026. The sponsor retains at least 5% of each class to satisfy credit risk retention. Watch secondary spread performance and collateral loss trends.
